name: Ranger Wild Strike off-hand helper deals weapon damage, not a flat 319 (#4543, #4002)
contract: Wild Strike (800083 and ranks 501724-501734, SpellFamilyName 27) carries SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL in slot 2 pointing at the shared helper Wild Strike (Off Hand) 560962. The parent's visible text promises only 'If dual wielding, deals additional Weapon Damage with your off-hand weapon'. 560962 has a single slot: SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG with EffectBasePoints 318 and EffectDieSides 1. Spell::EffectWeaponDmg accumulates a NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG slot's value into fixed_bonus (src/server/game/Spells/SpellEffects.cpp), so that payload adds a flat +319 on top of normalized off-hand weapon damage at every rank and every level, which the native 0.5 off-hand modifier turns into roughly +160. 560962 carries no SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE slot, so normalized weapon damage alone is the whole contract. A level 10 Ranger dual-wielding two Worn Shortswords (item 25, 1-3 damage) must therefore see a two-digit off-hand hit. The uncorrected payload lands about 160. The count assertion exists so the max assertion cannot pass vacuously when the off-hand hit never fires.

steps.label: off hand is equipped so the helper can fire
